findings.message: 4 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Clipping" above "Clip the match."; "Stats" above "Keep the stats."; "Drills" above "Draw the drills."; "Listening" above "“Shot, ours, score, number 12.”"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 2 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.promo-frame → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) 0px 40px 120px -24px | div.promo-frame.mx-auto → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) 0px 40px 120px -24px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 19 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.code-hero-top 1440px | section#see-it.border-y.border-line 1440px | div.grid.gap-2 672px | div.grid.gap-2 672px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Remove unless it is a real drop zone.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.
